channel.title: 021 LIFE Podcast
channel.itunes:summary:
All people are made to be Creators.
Yet we all face that voice: "Do something else."
Creators single-handedly make the world go round, yet they do it with one hand tied behind their back.
At the 021 LIFE Podcast, we turn Creators into CoCreators, connecting them with God (The Creator), so they can reach their personal maximum velocity.
Why?
Because Creators are God's chosen people.
https://www.021.life
